name: spice-ify
description: Spicetify extension: highest-capability Spotify tier, and the only one that needs no owner Premium.

scripts.install-ext: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.spicetify/Extensions && cp dist/spice-ify.js ~/.spicetify/Extensions/ && echo 'now run: spicetify config extensions spice-ify.js && spicetify apply'
